        async function updateSidebarWeather(cityKey) {
            const container = document.getElementById('sidebarWeatherWidget');
            if (!container) return;

            const coords = SEDE_COORDS[cityKey];
            if (!coords) {
                updateSidebarWeather('LIM');
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = `
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between animate-pulse">
                    <span class="text-xs text-gray-500">Cargando clima de ${coords.name}...</span>
                    <ion-icon name="cloud-outline" class="text-gray-600 animate-bounce"></ion-icon>
                </div>
            `;

            try {
                const res = await fetch(`https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${coords.lat}&longitude=${coords.lon}&current_weather=true`);
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error();
                const data = await res.json();
                const temp = Math.round(data.current_weather.temperature);
                const code = data.current_weather.weathercode;
                
                let icon = 'sunny-outline';
                let desc = 'Despejado';
                let color = 'text-amber-400';
                
                if (code >= 1 && code <= 3) { icon = 'cloudy-outline'; desc = 'Nublado'; color = 'text-gray-400'; }
                else if (code >= 51 && code <= 67) { icon = 'rainy-outline'; desc = 'Llovizna'; color = 'text-blue-400'; }
                else if (code >= 71 && code <= 82) { icon = 'snow-outline'; desc = 'Nieve'; color = 'text-sky-300'; }
                else if (code >= 95) { icon = 'thunderstorm-outline'; desc = 'Tormenta'; color = 'text-red-400'; }
                
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#111820]/40 border border-gray-800/40 p-3 rounded-xl hover:border-crearCyan/30 transition-all duration-300 group/weather">
                        <div class="flex flex-col">
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest">CLIMA ACTUAL</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 mt-1">${coords.name}</span>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-medium">${desc}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                            <ion-icon name="${icon}" class="text-2xl ${color} drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_currentColor] group-hover/weather:scale-110 transition-transform duration-300"></ion-icon>
                            <span class="text-xl font-black text-white leading-none">${temp}°C</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            } catch (e) {
                const mockTemps = { 'LIM': 19, 'UIO C1': 14, 'UIO C2': 14, 'GYE': 28, 'CUE': 15, 'MED': 22, 'MEX': 20 };
                const temp = mockTemps[cityKey] || 20;
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#111820]/40 border border-gray-800/40 p-3 rounded-xl hover:border-crearCyan/30 transition-all duration-300 group/weather">
                        <div class="flex flex-col">
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest">CLIMA ACTUAL</span>
                            <span class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200 mt-1">${coords.name}</span>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-medium">Conexión local activa</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                            <ion-icon name="cloud-outline" class="text-2xl text-crearCyan drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(41,171,226,0.4)] group-hover/weather:scale-110 transition-transform duration-300"></ion-icon>
                            <span class="text-xl font-black text-white leading-none">${temp}°C</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
        }

        function renderSidebar() {
            const container = document.getElementById('sidebarSedes');
            if (!container) return;

            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const userEmail = urlParams.get('email') || sessionStorage.getItem('crear_user_email') || 'usuario@crearpsl.com';
            const userName = urlParams.get('name') || sessionStorage.getItem('crear_user_name') || userEmail.split('@')[0];
            sessionStorage.setItem('crear_user_email', userEmail);
            sessionStorage.setItem('crear_user_name', userName);
            const userShort = userEmail.split('@')[0];

            const sedesFullMap = {
                'ALL_C1': { name: 'PRÓXIMOS C1', emoji: '🚀', icon: 'rocket-outline' },
                'CURRENT': { name: 'ACTUALES', emoji: '🔥', icon: 'flame-outline' },
                'UPCOMING': { name: 'TODOS LOS PRÓXIMOS', emoji: '🔮', icon: 'calendar-outline' },
                'VUELOS': { name: 'TRACKER VUELOS', emoji: '✈️', icon: 'airplane-outline' },
                'UIO C1': { name: 'QUITO C1', flag: 'https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg', icon: 'business-outline' },
                'UIO C2': { name: 'QUITO C2', flag: 'https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg', icon: 'business-outline' },
                'GYE': { name: 'GUAYAQUIL', flag: 'https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg', icon: 'business-outline' },
                'CUE': { name: 'CUENCA', flag: 'https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg', icon: 'business-outline' },
                'LIM': { name: 'LIMA', flag: 'https://flagcdn.com/pe.svg', icon: 'business-outline' },
                'MED': { name: 'MEDELLÍN', flag: 'https://flagcdn.com/co.svg', icon: 'business-outline' },
                'MEX': { name: 'CDMX', flag: 'https://flagcdn.com/mx.svg', icon: 'business-outline' }
            };

            const orderedCities = ['UIO C1', 'UIO C2', 'GYE', 'CUE', 'LIM', 'MED', 'MEX'];
            const tabKeys = ['ALL_C1', 'CURRENT', 'UPCOMING'];
            orderedCities.forEach(city => {
                if (allEventsData[city]) {
                    tabKeys.push(city);
                }
            });

            container.innerHTML = '';

            const accountDiv = document.createElement('div');
            accountDiv.className = "bg-[#111820]/40 border border-gray-800/40 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between mb-4 hover:border-gray-800 transition-colors";
            accountDiv.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="h-10 w-10 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-crearCyan/10 border border-crearCyan/20 flex items-center justify-center text-crearCyan text-sm font-black uppercase animate-pulse">
                        ${userName.substring(0, 2)}
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                        <span class="text-xs font-black text-white truncate uppercase tracking-wide">${userName}</span>
                        <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 truncate font-semibold">${userEmail}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button onclick="handleSidebarLogout()" title="Cerrar sesión" class="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400 text-gray-500 flex items-center justify-center transition-all active:scale-90 cursor-pointer">
                    <ion-icon name="log-out-outline" class="text-lg"></ion-icon>
                </button>
            `;
            container.appendChild(accountDiv);

            const weatherDiv = document.createElement('div');
            weatherDiv.id = "sidebarWeatherWidget";
            weatherDiv.className = "mb-4";
            container.appendChild(weatherDiv);
            updateSidebarWeather(activeSede);

            const actionsHeader = document.createElement('h3');
            actionsHeader.className = "text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-2.5 pl-2 flex items-center gap-1.5";
            actionsHeader.innerHTML = `<ion-icon name="grid-outline" class="text-gray-500"></ion-icon> Herramientas`;
            container.appendChild(actionsHeader);

            const actionsDiv = document.createElement('div');
            actionsDiv.className = "mb-6";
            
            const syncBtn = document.createElement('button');
            syncBtn.className = "w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-[#111820]/50 border border-gray-800 hover:border-crearCyan/50 hover:bg-crearCyan/5 p-3.5 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 active:scale-95 group cursor-pointer text-center";
            syncBtn.onclick = (e) => manualSync(e);
            syncBtn.innerHTML = `
                <ion-icon name="sync-outline" class="text-xl text-crearCyan group-hover:rotate-180 transition-transform duration-700"></ion-icon>
                <span class="text-xs font-bold text-gray-300 group-hover:text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Sincronizar Sheets</span>
            `;
            actionsDiv.appendChild(syncBtn);
            container.appendChild(actionsDiv);

            const isAutoSync = localStorage.getItem('autoSyncEnabled') !== 'false';
            const syncStatusDiv = document.createElement('div');
            syncStatusDiv.className = "bg-[#111820]/40 border border-gray-800/40 p-3.5 rounded-xl mb-6 space-y-2.5";
            syncStatusDiv.innerHTML = `
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        Sincronización IA
                    </span>
                    <label class="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer select-none">
                        <input type="checkbox" id="autoSyncToggle" class="sr-only peer" ${isAutoSync ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleAutoSyncState()">
                        <div class="w-9 h-5 bg-gray-800 peer-focus:outline-none rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-[2px] after:left-[2px] after:bg-gray-400 after:border-gray-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-4 after:w-4 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-crearCyan peer-checked:after:bg-[#060d14]"></div>
                    </label>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-gray-400 border-t border-gray-800/50 pt-2 font-medium">
                    <span>Estado:</span>
                    <span id="syncStatusBadge" class="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${isAutoSync ? 'text-crearCyan' : 'text-gray-500'}">
                        ${isAutoSync ? 'En vivo' : 'Pausada'}
                    </span>
                </div>
            `;
            container.appendChild(syncStatusDiv);

            const navHeader = document.createElement('h3');
            navHeader.className = "text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-2.5 pl-2 flex items-center gap-1.5";
            navHeader.innerHTML = `<ion-icon name="map-outline" class="text-gray-500"></ion-icon> Navegación`;
            container.appendChild(navHeader);

            const navContainer = document.createElement('div');
            navContainer.className = "space-y-1.5";

            tabKeys.forEach(key => {
                const conf = sedesFullMap[key];
                if (!conf) return;

                const isSelected = key === activeSede;
                const navItem = document.createElement('button');
                navItem.className = `w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border flex items-center justify-between text-left transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer active:scale-[0.98] ${
                    isSelected 
                        ? 'bg-crearCyan/10 border-crearCyan/50 text-white font-extrabold shadow-md shadow-crearCyan/5' 
                        : 'bg-transparent border-transparent hover:bg-gray-800/25 hover:border-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200 font-bold'
                }`;
                navItem.onclick = () => selectSedeFromSidebar(key);

                let flagOrIconHTML = '';
                if (conf.flag) {
                    flagOrIconHTML = `<img src="${conf.flag}" class="w-4.5 h-3 rounded-sm object-cover shrink-0">`;
                } else if (conf.icon) {
                    flagOrIconHTML = `<ion-icon name="${conf.icon}" class="text-lg ${isSelected ? 'text-crearCyan' : 'text-gray-500'} shrink-0"></ion-icon>`;
                }

                let countHTML = '';
                if (key !== 'VUELOS') {
                    let evList = [];
                    if (key === 'ALL_C1') {
                        evList = getEventsForTab('upcoming').filter(ev => cleanEquipoFormula(ev.equipo).toUpperCase().includes('C1'));
                    } else if (key === 'CURRENT') {
                        evList = getEventsForTab('current');
                    } else if (key === 'UPCOMING') {
                        evList = getEventsForTab('upcoming');
                    } else {
                        evList = allEventsData[key] || [];
                    }
                    const count = evList.length;
                    countHTML = `<span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black ${isSelected ? 'bg-crearCyan text-[#060d14]' : 'bg-[#111820] text-gray-500 border border-gray-800'}">${count}</span>`;
                }

                navItem.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                        ${flagOrIconHTML}
                        <span class="text-xs tracking-wide truncate uppercase">${conf.name}</span>
                    </div>
                    ${countHTML}
                `;
                navContainer.appendChild(navItem);
            });

            container.appendChild(navContainer);
        }

        function toggleAutoSyncState() {
            const tgl = document.getElementById('autoSyncToggle');
            if (!tgl) return;
            localStorage.setItem('autoSyncEnabled', tgl.checked ? 'true' : 'false');
            const badge = document.getElementById('syncStatusBadge');
            if (badge) {
                if (tgl.checked) {
                    badge.textContent = 'En vivo';
                    badge.className = 'font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-crearCyan';
                    startSync();
                } else {
                    badge.textContent = 'Pausada';
                    badge.className = 'font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500';
                    stopSync();
                }
            }
        }

        function handleSidebarLogout() {
            if (confirm('¿Seguro que deseas cerrar la sesión del Centro de Inteligencia?')) {
                sessionStorage.clear();
                window.location.reload();
            }
        }

        function selectSedeFromSidebar(sedeKey) {
            activeSede = sedeKey;
            renderSedeTabs();
            renderEvents(document.getElementById('searchInput').value || '');
            renderSidebar();
            
            if (window.innerWidth < 1024) {
                toggleSidebar();
            }
        }

        function getEventsForTab(timeframe) {
            const upcomingList = [];
            const currentList = [];
            
            Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(city => {
                allEventsData[city].forEach(ev => {
                    const status = getEventStatus(ev.start, ev.end);
                    if (status === 'upcoming') upcomingList.push(ev);
                    else if (status === 'current') currentList.push(ev);
                });
            });

            if (timeframe === 'upcoming') {
                return upcomingList.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.start) - new Date(b.start));
            }
            if (timeframe === 'current') {
                return currentList;
            }
            return [];
        }
    </script>

    <script>
        function normalizeSedeKey(sede) {
            if (!sede) return 'LIM';
            const norm = sede.trim().toUpperCase();
            if (norm === 'CDMX' || norm === 'MEX' || norm === 'MEXICO' || norm === 'MÉXICO' || norm === 'CIUDAD DE MEXICO' || norm === 'CIUDAD DE MÉXICO' || norm === 'MX') {
                return 'MEX';
            }
            if (norm === 'LIMA' || norm === 'LIM') {
                return 'LIM';
            }
            if (norm === 'QUITO' || norm === 'UIO' || norm === 'UIO C1' || norm === 'QUITO C1') {
                return 'UIO C1';
            }
            if (norm === 'QUITO C2' || norm === 'UIO C2') {
                return 'UIO C2';
            }
            if (norm === 'GUAYAQUIL' || norm === 'GYE') {
                return 'GYE';
            }
            if (norm === 'CUENCA' || norm === 'CUE') {
                return 'CUE';
            }
            if (norm === 'MEDELLIN' || norm === 'MEDELLÍN' || norm === 'MED') {
                return 'MED';
            }
            return norm;
        }

        function cleanEquipoFormula(equipo) {
            if (!equipo) return '';
            equipo = String(equipo).trim();
            // Si termina en .0, quitarlo (ej: 29.0 -> 29)
            if (/^\d+\.0+$/.test(equipo)) {
                return equipo.split('.')[0];
            }
            if (!equipo.startsWith('=')) {
                return equipo;
            }
            try {
                let formula = equipo.substring(1).toUpperCase(); // quitar '='
                
                // Manejar CONCATENATE
                if (formula.startsWith('CONCATENATE(')) {
                    let inner = formula.substring(12, formula.lastIndexOf(')'));
                    let parts = inner.split(',').map(p => {
                        p = p.trim().replace(/^["']|["']$/g, ''); // quitar comillas
                        let m = p.match(/^D(\d+)$/i);
                        if (m) return m[1];
                        return p;
                    });
                    return parts.filter(p => p !== '').join('');
                }
                
                formula = formula.replace(/^\+/, '');
                formula = formula.replace(/D(\d+)/gi, '$1');
                
                if (/^[0-9+\-*/().\s]+$/.test(formula)) {
                    let res = Function(`"use strict"; return (${formula})`)();
                    return String(res);
                }
                return formula;
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn('Error al parsear fórmula de equipo:', equipo, e);
                let digits = equipo.match(/\d+/g);
                if (digits && digits.length > 0) {
                    return digits.join(' y ');
                }
                return equipo;
            }
        }

        const allSedeCoords = {"UIO C1": {"lat": -0.1807, "lon": -78.4678}, "UIO C2": {"lat": -0.1807, "lon": -78.4678}, "GYE": {"lat": -2.1962, "lon": -79.8862}, "MED": {"lat": 6.2442, "lon": -75.5812}, "CUE": {"lat": -2.9001, "lon": -79.0059}, "LIM": {"lat": -12.0464, "lon": -77.0428}, "MEX": {"lat": 19.4326, "lon": -99.1332}};
        const encryptedTrainerData = "";
        let trainerData = {};
        // Unificación reactiva de allEventsData para sincronizar referencias de ambos bloques script
        if (!window._allEventsData) {
            window._allEventsData = window.allEventsData || {};
        }

        function getHolidaysAndEvents(country, startStr, endStr) {

            const results = [];

                const year = d.getFullYear();
                const month = d.getMonth() + 1;
                const date = d.getDate();
                const dayOfWeek = d.getDay();
                const dateKey = `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                const monthDayKey = `${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(date).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                
                if (monthDayKey === '01-01') results.push('Año Nuevo 🎉');
                if (monthDayKey === '05-01') results.push('Día del Trabajo 🔨');
                if (monthDayKey === '12-25') results.push('Navidad 🎄');
                
                if (month === 5 && dayOfWeek === 0) {
                    const firstSunday = new Date(year, 4, 1);

                    const secondSunday = new Date(firstSunday);
                    secondSunday.setDate(secondSunday.getDate() + 7);
                    if (d.getDate() === secondSunday.getDate()) results.push("Día de la Madre 👩‍👦");
                }
                
                if (month === 6 && dayOfWeek === 0) {

                    const thirdSunday = new Date(firstSunday);
                    thirdSunday.setDate(thirdSunday.getDate() + 14);
                    if (d.getDate() === thirdSunday.getDate()) results.push("Día del Padre 👨‍👦");
                }
