                }
                
                if (dateKey === '2026-04-02' || dateKey === '2026-04-03') results.push('Semana Santa ⛪');
                if (dateKey === '2027-03-25' || dateKey === '2027-03-26') results.push('Semana Santa ⛪');
                if (dateKey === '2028-04-13' || dateKey === '2028-04-14') results.push('Semana Santa ⛪');
                if (dateKey === '2029-03-29' || dateKey === '2029-03-30') results.push('Semana Santa ⛪');
                if (dateKey === '2030-04-18' || dateKey === '2030-04-19') results.push('Semana Santa ⛪');
            }
            return [...new Set(results)];
        }

        const monthNames = ['Enero', 'Febrero', 'Marzo', 'Abril', 'Mayo', 'Junio', 'Julio', 'Agosto', 'Septiembre', 'Octubre', 'Noviembre', 'Diciembre'];
        const dayNames = ['Domingo', 'Lunes', 'Martes', 'Miércoles', 'Jueves', 'Viernes', 'Sábado'];

        let activeTab = 'upcoming'; // 'upcoming' or 'past'
        let activeSede = 'ALL_C1'; // Default virtual tab

        function renderSedeTabs() {
            const container = document.getElementById('sedeTabs');
            if(!container) return;
            container.innerHTML = '';
            
            const sedesFullMap = {
                'ALL_C1': 'PRÓXIMOS C1 🚀',
                'CURRENT': '⚡ ACTUALES 🔥',
                'UPCOMING': '📅 PRÓXIMOS 🔮',
                'VUELOS': '✈️ VUELOS',
                'UIO C1': 'QUITO C1 <img src="https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg" class="inline w-4 h-3 ml-1 rounded-sm object-cover">',
                'UIO C2': 'QUITO C2 <img src="https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg" class="inline w-4 h-3 ml-1 rounded-sm object-cover">',
                'GYE': 'GUAYAQUIL <img src="https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg" class="inline w-4 h-3 ml-1 rounded-sm object-cover">',
                'CUE': 'CUENCA <img src="https://flagcdn.com/ec.svg" class="inline w-4 h-3 ml-1 rounded-sm object-cover">',
                'LIM': 'LIMA <img src="https://flagcdn.com/pe.svg" class="inline w-4 h-3 ml-1 rounded-sm object-cover">',
                'MED': 'MEDELLÍN <img src="https://flagcdn.com/co.svg" class="inline w-4 h-3 ml-1 rounded-sm object-cover">',
                'MEX': 'CDMX <img src="https://flagcdn.com/mx.svg" class="inline w-4 h-3 ml-1 rounded-sm object-cover">'
            };
            
            const orderedCities = ['UIO C1', 'UIO C2', 'GYE', 'CUE', 'LIM', 'MED', 'MEX'];
            const tabKeys = ['ALL_C1', 'CURRENT', 'UPCOMING'];
            orderedCities.forEach(city => {
                if (allEventsData[city]) {
                    tabKeys.push(city);
                }
            });
            
            tabKeys.forEach(sedeKey => {
                const isSelected = sedeKey === activeSede;
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = `whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-t-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center ${isSelected ? 'bg-crearCyan text-[#060d14]' : 'bg-[#111820] text-gray-400 hover:bg-[#1a2430] hover:text-white border border-gray-800 border-b-0'}`;
                btn.innerHTML = sedesFullMap[sedeKey] || sedeKey;
                btn.onclick = () => {
                    activeSede = sedeKey;
                    renderSedeTabs();
                    renderEvents(document.getElementById('searchInput').value);
                };
                container.appendChild(btn);
            });
            if (typeof renderSidebar === 'function') {
                renderSidebar();
            }
        }

        // Utilidad de Limpieza para Búsqueda (Quita tildes)
        const normalizeStr = (str) => {
            if(!str) return '';
            return str.normalize("NFD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "").toLowerCase();
        }

        function formatDateRange(startStr, endStr) {
            const start = new Date(startStr);
            const end = new Date(endStr);
            start.setMinutes(start.getMinutes() + start.getTimezoneOffset());
            end.setMinutes(end.getMinutes() + end.getTimezoneOffset());
            
            if(start.getMonth() === end.getMonth()) {
                return `${start.getDate()} al ${end.getDate()} de ${monthNames[start.getMonth()]} ${start.getFullYear()}`;
            } else {
                return `${start.getDate()} ${monthNames[start.getMonth()]} al ${end.getDate()} ${monthNames[end.getMonth()]} ${start.getFullYear()}`;
            }
        }

        function getEventStatus(startStr, endStr) {
            const now = new Date();
            now.setHours(0,0,0,0);
            
            const start = new Date(startStr);
            start.setMinutes(start.getMinutes() + start.getTimezoneOffset());
            start.setHours(0,0,0,0);
            
            const end = new Date(endStr);
            end.setMinutes(end.getMinutes() + end.getTimezoneOffset());
            end.setHours(23,59,59,999);
            
            if (now >= start && now <= end) return 'current';
            if (now < start) return 'upcoming';
            return 'past';
        }

        function fetchWeather(lat, lon, eventStart, widgetId) {
            const now = new Date();
            const start = new Date(eventStart);
            start.setMinutes(start.getMinutes() + start.getTimezoneOffset());
            
            const diffTime = start.getTime() - now.getTime();
            const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
            
            const widget = document.getElementById(widgetId);
            if(!widget) return;
            
            if(diffDays < 0) {
                widget.innerHTML = `<ion-icon name="checkmark-done-circle" aria-hidden="true" class="text-green-500"></ion-icon> Realizado`;
                return;
            }
            if(diffDays > 14) {
                widget.innerHTML = `<ion-icon name="partly-sunny" aria-hidden="true" class="text-yellow-500"></ion-icon> Pendiente`;
                return;
            }

            widget.innerHTML = `<div class="w-3 h-3 border-2 border-crearCyan border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>`;

            fetch(`https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${lat.lat}&longitude=${lat.lon}&daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,weathercode&timezone=auto`)
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    const targetDateStr = start.toISOString().split('T')[0];
                    const idx = data.daily.time.indexOf(targetDateStr);
                    if(idx !== -1) {
                        const tMax = data.daily.temperature_2m_max[idx];
                        const code = data.daily.weathercode[idx];
                        
                        let icon = 'partly-sunny';
                        let color = 'text-yellow-500';
                        if(code <= 3) { icon = 'sunny'; color = 'text-yellow-400'; }
                        else if(code <= 69) { icon = 'rainy'; color = 'text-blue-400'; }
                        else if(code <= 99) { icon = 'thunderstorm'; color = 'text-purple-400'; }
                        
                        widget.innerHTML = `<ion-icon name="${icon}" aria-hidden="true" class="${color} text-lg"></ion-icon> <span class="font-bold text-white">${tMax}°C</span>`;
                    } else {
                         widget.innerHTML = `<ion-icon name="calendar-outline" aria-hidden="true" class="text-gray-400"></ion-icon> Sin datos`;
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    widget.innerHTML = `
                        <button onclick="fetchWeather({lat: ${lat.lat}, lon: ${lat.lon}}, '${eventStart}', '${widgetId}')" 
                                class="flex items-center gap-1 text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 transition-colors" 
                                aria-label="Error de red de clima. Clic para reintentar.">
                            <ion-icon name="refresh-outline" class="text-sm"></ion-icon> Reintentar
                        </button>
                    `;
                });
        }

        const container = document.getElementById('eventsContainer');
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
        const noResults = document.getElementById('noResults');
        const countVisible = document.getElementById('countVisible');
        const tabUpcoming = document.getElementById('tabUpcoming');
        const tabPast = document.getElementById('tabPast');

        function renderEvents(filterText = '') {
            container.innerHTML = '';
            let renderCount = 0;

            const lowerFilter = normalizeStr(filterText);

            let currentSedeEvents = [];
            const tabSelector = document.getElementById('tabSelectorContainer');
            const vuelosDash = document.getElementById('vuelosActivosDashboard');
            const filterSection = document.getElementById('filterLogisticsSection');
            const noResultsEl = document.getElementById('noResults');

            // ═══ TAB VUELOS: Mostrar dashboard de vuelos, ocultar eventos ═══
            if (activeSede === 'VUELOS') {
                if (tabSelector) tabSelector.classList.add('hidden');
                if (filterSection) filterSection.classList.add('hidden');
                container.style.display = 'none';
                if (noResultsEl) noResultsEl.classList.add('hidden');
                if (vuelosDash) {
                    vuelosDash.classList.remove('hidden');
                    renderVuelosActivosDashboard();
                }
                countVisible.textContent = '0';
                return;
            } else {
                // Para todos los demás tabs, ocultar vuelos y mostrar eventos
                container.style.display = '';
                if (vuelosDash) vuelosDash.classList.add('hidden');
                if (filterSection) filterSection.classList.add('hidden');
            }

            if (activeSede === 'ALL_C1') {
                if (tabSelector) tabSelector.classList.add('hidden');
                activeTab = 'upcoming'; // Force upcoming mode
                
                const compiled = [];
                Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(sKey => {
                    const sEvents = allEventsData[sKey] || [];
                    const c1Events = sEvents.filter(ev => {
                        const nameUpper = ev.name.toUpperCase();
                        const isC1 = nameUpper.includes("CAPITULO UNO") || nameUpper.includes("CAPÍTULO UNO");
                        const status = getEventStatus(ev.start, ev.end);
                        return isC1 && (status === 'upcoming' || status === 'current');
                    });
                    
                    if (c1Events.length > 0) {
                        c1Events.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.start) - new Date(b.start));
                        compiled.push({
                            ...c1Events[0],
                            sedeTag: sKey
                        });
                    }
                });
                currentSedeEvents = compiled;
            } else if (activeSede === 'CURRENT') {
                if (tabSelector) tabSelector.classList.add('hidden');
                activeTab = 'upcoming';
                
                const compiled = [];
                Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(sKey => {
                    const sEvents = allEventsData[sKey] || [];
                    sEvents.forEach(ev => {
                        const status = getEventStatus(ev.start, ev.end);
                        if (status === 'current') {
                            compiled.push({
                                ...ev,
                                sedeTag: sKey
                            });
                        }
                    });
                });
                compiled.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.start) - new Date(b.start));
                currentSedeEvents = compiled;
            } else if (activeSede === 'UPCOMING') {
                if (tabSelector) tabSelector.classList.add('hidden');
                activeTab = 'upcoming';
                
                const compiled = [];
                Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(sKey => {
                    const sEvents = allEventsData[sKey] || [];
                    sEvents.forEach(ev => {
                        const status = getEventStatus(ev.start, ev.end);
                        if (status === 'upcoming') {
                            compiled.push({
                                ...ev,
                                sedeTag: sKey
                            });
                        }
                    });
                });
                compiled.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.start) - new Date(b.start));
                currentSedeEvents = compiled;
            } else {
                if (tabSelector) tabSelector.classList.remove('hidden');
                currentSedeEvents = allEventsData[activeSede] || [];
            }

            // Copy, filter by logistics, and sort
            let eventsToRender = [...currentSedeEvents];
            
            if (currentFilter === 'ticket_pending') {
                eventsToRender = eventsToRender.filter(e => {
                    const log = e.logistics || { ticket: "pending", hotel: "pending", trainer_notified: false };
                    return log.ticket !== 'purchased';
                });
            } else if (currentFilter === 'hotel_pending') {
                eventsToRender = eventsToRender.filter(e => {
                    const log = e.logistics || { ticket: "pending", hotel: "pending", trainer_notified: false };
                    return log.hotel !== 'booked';
                });
            } else if (currentFilter === 'not_notified') {
                eventsToRender = eventsToRender.filter(e => {
                    const log = e.logistics || { ticket: "pending", hotel: "pending", trainer_notified: false };
                    return !log.trainer_notified;
                });
            }
            if (activeTab === 'past') {
                eventsToRender.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.start) - new Date(a.start));
            } else {
                eventsToRender.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.start) - new Date(b.start));
            }

            eventsToRender.forEach((ev, index) => {
                const status = getEventStatus(ev.start, ev.end);
                
                if (activeSede !== 'ALL_C1' && activeSede !== 'CURRENT' && activeSede !== 'UPCOMING') {
                    if (activeTab === 'upcoming' && status === 'past') return;
                    if (activeTab === 'past' && status !== 'past') return;
                }

                const startDateObj = new Date(ev.start);
                startDateObj.setMinutes(startDateObj.getMinutes() + startDateObj.getTimezoneOffset());
                const monthName = monthNames[startDateObj.getMonth()];
                const yearName = startDateObj.getFullYear().toString();
                const trainerName = ev.trainer || "Por confirmar";
                const placeName = ev.place || "Por confirmar";
                
                const log = ev.logistics || { ticket: "pending", hotel: "pending", trainer_notified: false, trainer_arrival: "" };
                
                const badgeTicket = log.ticket === 'purchased' 
                  ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="airplane-outline"></ion-icon> Tiquete</span>`
                  : log.ticket === 'in_process'
                  ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-400 border border-blue-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="hourglass-outline"></ion-icon> En Proceso</span>`
                  : `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-red-900/40 text-red-400 border border-red-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="alert-circle-outline"></ion-icon> Pendiente</span>`;

                const badgeHotel = log.hotel === 'booked' 
                  ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="bed-outline"></ion-icon> Reservado</span>`
                  : log.hotel === 'in_process'
                  ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-400 border border-blue-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="hourglass-outline"></ion-icon> En Proceso</span>`
                  : `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-red-900/40 text-red-400 border border-red-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="alert-circle-outline"></ion-icon> Pendiente</span>`;

                const badgeNotif = log.trainer_notified 
                  ? `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-300 border border-purple-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="mail-open-outline"></ion-icon> Avisado</span>`
                  : `<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-orange-900/40 text-orange-400 border border-orange-800/30 flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="mail-outline"></ion-icon> Sin Avisar</span>`;
                
                const searchString = normalizeStr(`${ev.name} equipo ${ev.equipo} ${monthName} ${yearName} ${trainerName} ${placeName} ${ev.sedeTag || ''}`);
                const searchTerms = lowerFilter.split(' ').filter(t => t.trim() !== '');
                const matches = searchTerms.every(term => searchString.includes(term));

                if (searchTerms.length > 0 && !matches) {
                    return;
                }

                let statusHtml = '';
                let opacityClass = 'opacity-100';
                let orderClass = '';

                if (status === 'current') {
                    statusHtml = `<span class="absolute -top-3 -right-3 bg-crearDarker border border-green-500/50 text-green-400 text-[10px] font-bold px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-2 shadow-xl z-10 uppercase tracking-wider"><div class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500 pulse-green"></div> EN CURSO</span>`;
                    orderClass = 'order-1 ring-1 ring-green-500/40 bg-green-900/10';
                } else if (status === 'upcoming') {
                    statusHtml = `<span class="absolute -top-3 -right-3 bg-crearDarker border border-crearCyan/50 text-crearCyan text-[10px] font-bold px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-xl z-10 uppercase tracking-wider">PRÓXIMO</span>`;
                    orderClass = 'order-2';
                } else {
                    opacityClass = 'opacity-80 hover:opacity-100';
                    orderClass = 'order-3';
                }

                const dateRange = formatDateRange(ev.start, ev.end);
                let mapsButton = '';
                if(ev.address) {
                    const mapsUrl = `https://maps.google.com/?q=${encodeURIComponent(ev.address)}`;
                    mapsButton = `
                        <a href="${mapsUrl}" target="_blank" class="flex-1 bg-gray-800/50 hover:bg-crearCyan hover:text-crearDarker border border-gray-700 hover:border-crearCyan text-white text-[11px] font-bold py-2 px-3 rounded-lg flex justify-center items-center gap-1.5 transition-all">
                            <ion-icon name="location" class="text-sm"></ion-icon> Ver Mapa
                        </a>
                    `;
                }

                const weatherWidgetId = `weather-${index}`;
                const sedeLabel = ev.sedeTag ? `<span class="bg-crearCyan/20 text-crearCyan text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md mb-1.5 inline-block mr-1.5">${ev.sedeTag}</span>` : '';

                // Calculate countdown label for events in the next 30 days
                const today = new Date();
                today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                const eventStart = new Date(ev.start);
                eventStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
                const diffDays = Math.ceil((eventStart - today) / 86400000);
                const countdownLabel = (diffDays > 0 && diffDays <= 30) 
                  ? `<span class="bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md mb-1.5 inline-block flex items-center gap-1"><ion-icon name="time-outline" class="text-xs"></ion-icon> Faltan ${diffDays} días</span>` 
                  : '';

                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = `glass-card rounded-2xl p-6 relative flex flex-col justify-between group ${opacityClass} ${orderClass}`;
                card.innerHTML = `
                    ${statusHtml}
                    <div>
                        <div class="flex items-start gap-4 mb-5">
                            <div class="bg-crearDarker border border-crearBorder rounded-xl p-3 text-center min-w-[70px] shadow-inner group-hover:border-crearCyan/50 transition-colors">
                                <span class="block text-crearCyan text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase mb-0.5">${monthName.substring(0,3)}</span>
                                <span class="block text-white text-2xl font-black leading-none">${startDateObj.getDate()}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="pt-1">
                                ${sedeLabel}
                                <span class="bg-crearBlue/20 text-crearCyan text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md mb-1.5 inline-block">Equipo ${ev.equipo || 'N/A'}</span>
                                ${countdownLabel}
                                <h4 class="text-white font-extrabold text-lg leading-tight group-hover:text-crearCyan transition-colors">${ev.name}</h4>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="space-y-3 mb-5">
                            <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
                                <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-gray-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                                    <ion-icon name="person" class="text-gray-400 text-xs"></ion-icon>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Entrenador</p>
                                    ${trainerName !== 'Por confirmar' ? `
                                    <button onclick="openTrainerDrawer('${trainerName.replace(/'/g, "\'")}')" class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium text-left cursor-pointer border-b border-dashed border-gray-500 hover:text-crearCyan hover:border-crearCyan transition-colors flex items-center gap-1">
                                        <span>${trainerName}</span>
                                        <ion-icon name="card-outline" class="text-xs text-crearCyan/70"></ion-icon>
                                    </button>
                                    ` : `
                                    <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">${trainerName}</p>
                                    `}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
                                 <div class="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-gray-800 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                                     <ion-icon name="business" class="text-gray-400 text-xs"></ion-icon>
                                 </div>
                                 <div>
                                     <p class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Locación</p>
                                     <p class="text-sm text-gray-200 font-medium">${placeName}</p>
                                 </div>
                             </div>

                             <!-- Logistics Section -->
                             <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-crearBorder/40">
                                 <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                                     <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block flex items-center gap-1">
                                         Logística de Entrenador
                                         ${(log.ticket !== 'pending' || log.hotel !== 'pending' || log.trainer_notified) ? '<span class="text-emerald-400 font-black text-xs" title="Actualizado">✓</span>' : ''}
                                     </span>
                                     <button onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openLogisticsDrawer('${ev.equipo}', '${ev.start}')" class="text-[10px] text-crearCyan hover:text-cyan-400 hover:underline font-bold flex items-center gap-1" aria-label="Gestionar logística de este evento">
                                         <ion-icon name="create-outline"></ion-icon> Gestionar
                                     </button>
                                 </div>
                                 <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                                     ${badgeTicket} ${badgeHotel} ${badgeNotif}
                                 </div>
                                 ${log.trainer_arrival ? `
                                 <div class="mt-2 text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
                                     <ion-icon name="calendar-outline" class="text-crearCyan"></ion-icon> Llegada real: <span class="text-white font-mono font-bold">${log.trainer_arrival}</span>
                                 </div>
                                 ` : ''}
                             </div>
                             
                             <!-- Eventos especiales y Feriados locales -->
                             ${(() => {
                                 const countryCodeMap = {
                                     'LIM': 'PE',
                                     'UIO C1': 'EC',
                                     'UIO C2': 'EC',
                                     'GYE': 'EC',
                                     'CUE': 'EC',
                                     'MED': 'CO',
                                     'MEX': 'MX'
                                 };
                                 const cCode = countryCodeMap[activeSede] || 'EC';
                                 const hList = getHolidaysAndEvents(cCode, ev.start, ev.end);
                                 if (hList.length === 0) return '';
                                 return `
                                 <div class="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-crearBorder/40">
                                     <span class="text-[8px] text-gray-500 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1">Días Especiales / Feriados</span>
                                     <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                                         ${hList.map(h => `
                                             <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 text-[9px] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                                                 <ion-icon name="calendar-outline"></ion-icon> ${h}
                                             </span>
                                         `).join('')}
                                     </div>
                                 </div>
                                 `;
                             })()}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div>
                        <div class="border-t border-crearBorder/80 pt-4 flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-400 text-xs font-medium">
                                <ion-icon name="calendar-outline" class="text-crearCyan"></ion-icon>
                                <span>${dateRange}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div id="${weatherWidgetId}" class="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-gray-400 bg-black/30 px-2 py-1 rounded-md weather-widget">
                                <div class="w-3 h-3 border-2 border-crearCyan border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div class="flex gap-2">
                            ${mapsButton}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
                
                // Only fetch weather if not past to save API calls
                if(status !== 'past') {
                    fetchWeather(allSedeCoords[activeSede] || allSedeCoords['UIO C1'], ev.start, weatherWidgetId);
                } else {
                    const wgt = document.getElementById(weatherWidgetId);
                    if(wgt) wgt.innerHTML = `<ion-icon name="checkmark-done-circle" class="text-gray-500"></ion-icon> Realizado`;
                }
                
                renderCount++;
            });

            countVisible.textContent = renderCount;

            if (renderCount === 0) {
                noResults.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                noResults.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            renderEvents(e.target.value);
        });

        tabUpcoming.addEventListener('click', () => {
            activeTab = 'upcoming';
            tabUpcoming.classList.replace('tab-inactive', 'tab-active');
            tabPast.classList.replace('tab-active', 'tab-inactive');
            renderEvents(searchInput.value);
        });

        tabPast.addEventListener('click', () => {
            activeTab = 'past';
            tabPast.classList.replace('tab-inactive', 'tab-active');
            tabUpcoming.classList.replace('tab-active', 'tab-inactive');
            renderEvents(searchInput.value);
        });

        function openTrainerDrawer(trainerName) {
            const drawer = document.getElementById('trainerDrawer');
            const panel = document.getElementById('trainerDrawerPanel');
            const body = document.getElementById('trainerDrawerBody');
            if(!drawer || !panel || !body) return;
            
            body.innerHTML = '';
            
            const trainersList = trainerName.split('/').map(t => t.trim().toUpperCase());
            const validTrainers = trainersList.filter(t => trainerData[t]);
            
            if(validTrainers.length === 0) return;
            
            validTrainers.forEach(tName => {
                const td = trainerData[tName];
                
                // Parse Passport Expiry
                const expiryParts = td.expiry ? td.expiry.split('/') : null;
                const expiryDate = expiryParts && expiryParts.length === 3 ? new Date(expiryParts[2], expiryParts[1]-1, expiryParts[0]) : null;
                const isExpired = expiryDate && expiryDate < new Date();
                const isExpiringSoon = expiryDate && !isExpired && expiryDate < new Date(Date.now() + 365*24*60*60*1000);
                
                // Parse Insurance Expiry
                const insExpiryParts = td.insurance_expiry && td.insurance_expiry !== 'N/A' && td.insurance_expiry !== 'Desconocida' ? td.insurance_expiry.split('/') : null;
                const insExpiryDate = insExpiryParts && insExpiryParts.length === 3 ? new Date(insExpiryParts[2], insExpiryParts[1]-1, insExpiryParts[0]) : null;
                const isInsExpired = insExpiryDate && insExpiryDate < new Date();
                const isInsExpiringSoon = insExpiryDate && !isInsExpired && insExpiryDate < new Date(Date.now() + 365*24*60*60*1000);
                
                const hasAlert = isExpired || isInsExpired;
                
                const passportCard = `
                <div class="passport-card-inner bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0a1628] via-[#0d1f3c] to-[#0a1628] backdrop-blur-xl border ${hasAlert ? 'border-red-500/50' : 'border-crearCyan/30'} rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl shrink-0">
                    <!-- Warning Banner if Expired -->
                    ${hasAlert ? `
                    <div class="bg-red-500/25 border-b border-red-500/35 text-red-400 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-pulse">
                        <ion-icon name="alert-circle" class="text-sm"></ion-icon>
                        <span>ALERTA: ${isExpired ? 'PASAPORTE VENCIDO ' : ''}${isExpired && isInsExpired ? 'y ' : ''}${isInsExpired ? 'SEGURO VENCIDO' : ''}</span>
                    </div>
                    ` : ''}

                    <!-- Header con shimmer -->
                    <div class="passport-shimmer px-4 py-3 border-b ${hasAlert ? 'border-red-500/20' : 'border-crearCyan/20'} flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <div class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-crearCyan/20 flex items-center justify-center">
                                <ion-icon name="shield-checkmark" class="text-crearCyan text-[10px]"></ion-icon>
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-[10px] text-crearCyan font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em]">Documento de Identidad</span>
                        </div>
                        <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 font-mono">${td.country_code || ''}</span>
                    </div>
                    
                    <!-- Body -->
                    <div class="p-5">
                        <div class="flex gap-4 mb-4">
                            <div class="shrink-0 flex -space-x-4 relative">
                                ${ev.trainer && ev.trainer.includes('/') ? 
                                    ev.trainer.split(/[\/-]/).slice(0, 3).map((t, i) => {
                                        const tName = t.trim();
                                        const tPhoto = (typeof photoDB !== 'undefined' && photoDB[normalizeStr(tName)]) ? photoDB[normalizeStr(tName)].photo : null;
                                        return tPhoto ? 
                                        `<img src="${tPhoto}" alt="${tName}" class="passport-photo-3d w-24 h-28 object-cover object-top rounded-lg border-2 shadow-md ${hasAlert ? 'border-red-500/40' : 'border-crearCyan/30'} relative z-${30-i*10} hover:z-40 hover:scale-105 transition-transform" style="margin-left: ${i > 0 ? '-3rem' : '0'}; z-index: ${30-i}">` :
                                        `<div class="shrink-0 w-24 h-28 rounded-lg border-2 ${hasAlert ? 'border-red-500/40' : 'border-crearCyan/30'} bg-crearBlue/10 flex items-center justify-center passport-photo-3d relative z-${30-i*10} hover:z-40" style="margin-left: ${i > 0 ? '-3rem' : '0'}; z-index: ${30-i}">
                                            <ion-icon name="person" class="text-crearCyan text-3xl"></ion-icon>
                                        </div>`;
                                    }).join('')
                                :
                                    (typeof td !== 'undefined' && td && td.photo ? `
                                        <img src="${td.photo}" alt="${td.name}" class="passport-photo-3d w-24 h-28 object-cover object-top rounded-lg border-2 shadow-md ${hasAlert ? 'border-red-500/40' : 'border-crearCyan/30'}">
                                    ` : `
                                        <div class="shrink-0 w-24 h-28 rounded-lg border-2 ${hasAlert ? 'border-red-500/40' : 'border-crearCyan/30'} bg-crearBlue/10 flex items-center justify-center passport-photo-3d">
                                            <ion-icon name="person" class="text-crearCyan text-3xl"></ion-icon>
                                        </div>
                                    `)
                                }
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                <p class="text-white font-black text-sm leading-tight mb-1">${td.name}</p>
                                <p class="text-crearCyan text-xs font-semibold mb-2">${td.nationality || ''}</p>
                                <div class="bg-black/40 rounded-md px-3 py-1 border ${isExpired ? 'border-red-500/30' : 'border-crearCyan/20'} inline-block">
                                    <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-400 font-medium block">Nº PASAPORTE</span>
                                    <span class="${isExpired ? 'text-red-500 font-bold' : 'text-crearCyan'} font-mono text-sm tracking-wider">${td.id || 'N/A'}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Grid de datos -->
                        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                            <div class="passport-field bg-[#0c1322] border border-gray-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
                                <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Fecha Nacimiento</span>
                                <span class="text-xs text-gray-200 font-semibold">${td.dob || 'N/A'}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="passport-field bg-[#0c1322] border border-gray-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2">
                                <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Vigencia Pasaporte</span>
                                <span class="text-xs font-black ${isExpired ? 'text-red-500 animate-pulse' : isExpiringSoon ? 'text-orange-400 font-bold' : 'text-emerald-400 font-semibold'}">${td.expiry || 'N/A'}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <!-- Seguro de Viaje -->
                        <div class="mt-3 bg-[#0b1622]/50 border ${isInsExpired ? 'border-red-500/30' : 'border-crearCyan/20'} rounded-lg p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${isInsExpired ? 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-500 animate-pulse' : (td.insurance_provider && td.insurance_provider !== 'No Registrado' ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400')}">
                                    <ion-icon name="${isInsExpired ? 'alert-circle' : (td.insurance_provider && td.insurance_provider !== 'No Registrado' ? 'shield-checkmark' : 'warning')}" class="text-lg"></ion-icon>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                    <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Seguro Médico / Viajero</span>
                                    <span class="text-xs ${isInsExpired ? 'text-red-500 font-black' : 'text-white'} font-semibold block truncate max-w-[150px]" title="${td.insurance_provider || 'No Registrado'}">${td.insurance_provider || 'No Registrado'}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            ${td.insurance_provider && td.insurance_provider !== 'No Registrado' ? `
                            <div class="text-right">
                                <span class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Vigencia</span>
                                <span class="text-xs ${isInsExpired ? 'text-red-500 font-black animate-pulse' : isInsExpiringSoon ? 'text-orange-400 font-bold' : 'text-emerald-400 font-semibold'} block">${td.insurance_expiry || 'N/A'}</span>
                            </div>
                            ` : `
                            <span class="text-[9px] text-orange-400 font-semibold px-2 py-1 bg-orange-400/10 rounded border border-orange-400/20 uppercase tracking-widest">Pendiente</span>
                            `}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                `;
                body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', passportCard);
            });
            
            // Show Drawer
            drawer.classList.remove('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
            panel.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        }
        
        function closeTrainerDrawer() {
            const drawer = document.getElementById('trainerDrawer');
            const panel = document.getElementById('trainerDrawerPanel');
            if(!drawer || !panel) return;
            
            panel.classList.add('translate-x-full');
            drawer.classList.add('opacity-0', 'pointer-events-none');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';
        }

        let currentFilter = 'all';
        function filterLogistics(type, event) {
            currentFilter = type;
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.className = "filter-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#111820] text-gray-400 border border-gray-850 hover:bg-[#1a2430] hover:text-white transition-all";
            });
            
            let btnClass = "filter-btn px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all shadow-md ";
            if (type === 'all') {
                btnClass += "bg-crearCyan text-[#060d14] border border-crearCyan";
            } else if (type === 'ticket_pending' || type === 'hotel_pending') {
                btnClass += "bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/40";
            } else if (type === 'not_notified') {
                btnClass += "bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/40";
            }
            
            if (event && event.currentTarget) {
                event.currentTarget.className = btnClass;
            }
            renderEvents(document.getElementById('searchInput').value);
        }

        function mergeLogistics() {
            try {
                const raw = localStorage.getItem('crear_calendar_logistics');
                if (!raw) return;
                const logs = JSON.parse(raw);
                Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(sedeKey => {
                    allEventsData[sedeKey].forEach(ev => {
                        const logKey = `${ev.equipo}_${ev.start}`;
                        if (logs[logKey]) {
                            ev.logistics = { ticket: "pending", hotel: "pending", trainer_notified: false, trainer_arrival: "", ...logs[logKey] };
                        }
                    });
                });
            } catch (e) { console.warn("Logistics merge skipped:", e); }
        }

        function openLogisticsDrawer(equipo, dateStr) {
          // Buscar el evento en todas las sedes
          let ev = null;
          let sedeEncontrada = null;
          Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(s => {
            const found = allEventsData[s].find(e => e.equipo === equipo && e.start === dateStr);
            if (found) { ev = found; sedeEncontrada = s; }
          });
          
          if (!ev) return showToast('❌ Evento no encontrado', 'error');
          
          // Soporta Array o Objecto
          let logs = [];
          if (Array.isArray(ev.logistics)) {
              logs = ev.logistics;
          } else if (ev.logistics) {
              logs = [ev.logistics];
          }
          // Por defecto tomamos el primero, o vacio
          const log = logs[0] || { ticket: "pending", hotel: "pending", trainer_notified: false, trainer_arrival: "" };
          
          // Variables globales para uso en otras funciones
          currentEquipo = equipo;
          currentDateStr = dateStr;
          currentEventoId = `${(sedeEncontrada || 'LIM').substring(0,3).toUpperCase()}_E${equipo}_${dateStr.replace(/-/g,'').substring(0,8)}`;
          currentTrainerName = ev.trainer || '';
          
          // Eliminar modal anterior si existe
          const existingModal = document.getElementById('logisticsModal');
          if (existingModal) existingModal.remove();
          
          // Crear modal
          const modal = document.createElement('div');
          modal.className = 'fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 transition-all duration-300';
          modal.id = 'logisticsModal';
          modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-[#0a1628] to-[#060d14] border border-crearBorder rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md space-y-5 shadow-2xl relative max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
              
              <button onclick="document.getElementById('logisticsModal').remove()" class="absolute top-4 right-4 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-700 text-gray-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition-colors">
                <ion-icon name="close-outline" class="text-xl"></ion-icon>
              </button>
              
              <div>
                <span class="text-[9px] font-black text-crearCyan uppercase tracking-widest block mb-0.5">Centro de Control Logístico</span>
                <h3 class="text-white font-black text-lg uppercase">Gestión - Equipo ${ev.equipo}</h3>
                <p class="text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1 font-medium">${ev.name} · ${formatDateRange(ev.start, ev.end)}</p>
                <p class="text-gray-500 text-[10px] mt-0.5">👤 Entrenador: <span class="text-white font-bold">${ev.trainer || 'Por confirmar'}</span></p>
              </div>
              
              <div class="space-y-4">
                <!-- Tiquete -->
                <div class="bg-[#0b1622]/50 border border-crearBorder rounded-xl p-3">
                  <label class="block text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">✈️ Tiquete de Avión</label>
                  <select id="modal-ticket" class="w-full bg-[#080c11] border border-crearBorder text-xs text-white rounded-lg p-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-crearCyan transition-colors" onchange="updateLog('${equipo}', '${dateStr}', 'ticket', this.value)">
                    <option value="pending" ${log.ticket==='pending'?'selected':''}>❌ Pendiente</option>
                    <option value="in_process" ${log.ticket==='in_process'?'selected':''}>⏳ En Proceso</option>
                    <option value="purchased" ${log.ticket==='purchased'?'selected':''}>✅ Comprado</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Hotel -->
                <div class="bg-[#0b1622]/50 border border-crearBorder rounded-xl p-3">
                  <label class="block text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">🏨 Hospedaje / Hotel</label>
                  <select id="modal-hotel" class="w-full bg-[#080c11] border border-crearBorder text-xs text-white rounded-lg p-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-crearCyan transition-colors" onchange="updateLog('${equipo}', '${dateStr}', 'hotel', this.value)">
                    <option value="pending" ${log.hotel==='pending'?'selected':''}>❌ Pendiente</option>
                    <option value="in_process" ${log.hotel==='in_process'?'selected':''}>⏳ En Proceso</option>
                    <option value="booked" ${log.hotel==='booked'?'selected':''}>✅ Reservado</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                
                <!-- Llegada -->
                <div class="bg-[#0b1622]/50 border border-crearBorder rounded-xl p-3">
                  <label class="block text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">📅 Fecha de Llegada del Entrenador</label>
                  <input type="datetime-local" value="${log.trainer_arrival || ''}" onchange="updateLog('${equipo}', '${dateStr}', 'trainer_arrival', this.value)" class="w-full bg-[#080c11] border border-crearBorder text-xs text-white rounded-lg p-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-crearCyan transition-colors font-mono">
                </div>
                
                <!-- Notificación -->
                <div class="bg-[#0b1622]/50 border border-crearBorder rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <label class="block text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">📢 Notificación</label>
                    <span class="text-[11px] text-gray-200">¿Entrenador avisado e informado?</span>
                  </div>
                  <input type="checkbox" ${log.trainer_notified?'checked':''} onchange="updateLog('${equipo}', '${dateStr}', 'trainer_notified', this.checked)" class="accent-crearCyan w-5 h-5 rounded cursor-pointer">
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <!-- GESTIÓN DE VUELO + OCR -->
              <div class="mt-5 pt-5 border-t border-crearBorder/40">
                <h4 class="text-white font-bold text-xs mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <ion-icon name="airplane-outline" class="text-crearCyan"></ion-icon>
                  Gestión de Vuelo del Entrenador
                </h4>
                
                <label class="block cursor-pointer">
                  <input type="file" id="ticketFile" accept="image/*,application/pdf" class="hidden" onchange="procesarTiquete(event)">
                  <div class="bg-crearDark border-2 border-dashed border-crearBorder rounded-lg p-4 text-center hover:border-crearCyan transition">
                    <ion-icon name="cloud-upload-outline" class="text-3xl text-crearCyan"></ion-icon>
                    <p class="text-crearCyan text-xs font-bold mt-2">📎 Subir tiquete (imagen/PDF)</p>
                    <p class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 mt-1">El sistema leerá automáticamente los datos</p>
                  </div>
                </label>
                
                <div id="ocrProgress" class="hidden mt-3">
                  <div class="bg-crearDark rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                    <div id="ocrBar" class="bg-gradient-to-r from-crearCyan to-crearBlue h-full transition-all duration-300" style="width:0%"></div>
                  </div>
                  <p id="ocrStatus" class="text-[10px] text-crearCyan mt-1 text-center">Procesando...</p>
                </div>
                
                <!-- FORMULARIO DE VUELO (AHORA SE LLENA AUTOMÁTICAMENTE) -->
                <div id="flightDataForm" class="mt-3 space-y-2 ${log.aerolinea || log.numero_vuelo ? '' : 'hidden'}">
                  <input type="text" id="flightAerolinea" value="${log.aerolinea || ''}" placeholder="Aerolínea" class="w-full bg-crearDark border border-crearBorder text-white text-xs rounded-lg p-2">
                  <input type="text" id="flightNumero" value="${log.numero_vuelo || ''}" placeholder="Número de vuelo (ej: LA2456)" class="w-full bg-crearDark border border-crearBorder text-white text-xs rounded-lg p-2">
                  <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <input type="text" id="flightOrigen" value="${log.origen || ''}" placeholder="Origen (MEX)" class="bg-crearDark border border-crearBorder text-white text-xs rounded-lg p-2 uppercase">
                    <input type="text" id="flightDestino" value="${log.destino || ''}" placeholder="Destino (LIM)" class="bg-crearDark border border-crearBorder text-white text-xs rounded-lg p-2 uppercase">
                  </div>
                  <input type="text" id="flightPNR" value="${log.pnr || ''}" placeholder="PNR/Localizador (6 caracteres)" class="w-full bg-crearDark border border-crearBorder text-white text-xs rounded-lg p-2 uppercase">
                  <button onclick="guardarVuelo()" class="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-crearCyan to-crearBlue text-white font-bold text-xs py-2.5 rounded-lg hover:opacity-90 transition">💾 Guardar vuelo y rastrear</button>
                </div>
                
                <!-- TRACKING EN VIVO - LINKS DIRECTOS -->
                <div id="liveTrackingLinks" class="hidden mt-3 space-y-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-900/20 to-indigo-900/20 border border-blue-800/30 rounded-lg p-3">
                  <h5 class="text-[10px] font-black text-blue-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
                    <ion-icon name="radar-outline"></ion-icon> Rastreo en Vivo
                  </h5>
                  <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
                    <a id="link-flightradar" href="#" target="_blank" class="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0b1622] hover:bg-[#142033] border border-crearBorder rounded-lg p-2 transition-all group">
                      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span class="text-lg">🛫</span>
                        <div>
                          <div class="text-white text-xs font-bold">Flightradar24</div>
                          <div class="text-[9px] text-gray-500">Mapa en tiempo real</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ion-icon name="open-outline" class="text-gray-500 group-hover:text-crearCyan"></ion-icon>
                    </a>
                    <a id="link-flightaware" href="#" target="_blank" class="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0b1622] hover:bg-[#142033] border border-crearBorder rounded-lg p-2 transition-all group">
                      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span class="text-lg">📡</span>
                        <div>
                          <div class="text-white text-xs font-bold">FlightAware</div>
                          <div class="text-[9px] text-gray-500">Estado + horarios</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ion-icon name="open-outline" class="text-gray-500 group-hover:text-crearCyan"></ion-icon>
                    </a>
                    <a id="link-googleflights" href="#" target="_blank" class="flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0b1622] hover:bg-[#142033] border border-crearBorder rounded-lg p-2 transition-all group">
                      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span class="text-lg">🔍</span>
                        <div>
                          <div class="text-white text-xs font-bold">Google Flights</div>
                          <div class="text-[9px] text-gray-500">Búsqueda rápida</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ion-icon name="open-outline" class="text-gray-500 group-hover:text-crearCyan"></ion-icon>
                    </a>
                  </div>
                  <p class="text-[9px] text-gray-500 italic text-center mt-1">Los links se actualizan automáticamente con el número de vuelo</p>
                </div>
                
                <!-- ESTADO DEL VUELO -->
                <div id="flightStatus" class="hidden mt-3 bg-crearDark border border-crearBorder rounded-lg p-3 space-y-2">
                  <div class="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-bold">Estado del vuelo:</span>
                    <span id="flightStatusBadge" class="text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded"></span>
                  </div>
                  <div id="flightDetails" class="text-[10px] text-gray-300 space-y-1"></div>
                  <button onclick="refreshFlightStatus()" class="text-[9px] text-crearCyan hover:underline flex items-center gap-1">
                    <ion-icon name="refresh-outline"></ion-icon> Actualizar estado
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <button onclick="document.getElementById('logisticsModal').remove()" class="w-full bg-crearBorder hover:bg-crearBorder/80 text-gray-300 font-bold py-2 rounded-lg text-xs uppercase mt-2 cursor-pointer">Cerrar</button>
            </div>
          `;
          
          document.body.appendChild(modal);
          
          // Si ya hay datos del vuelo guardados, mostrarlos automáticamente
          if (log.aerolinea || log.numero_vuelo || log.pnr) {
            document.getElementById('flightDataForm').classList.remove('hidden');
            
            // Generar links de tracking automáticamente
            setTimeout(() => {
              actualizarLinksTracking();
              
              // Si hay número de vuelo, mostrar estado también
              if (log.numero_vuelo) {
                document.getElementById('flightStatus').classList.remove('hidden');
                refreshFlightStatus();
              }
            }, 100);
          }
        }

        function updateLog(equipo, dateStr, field, value) {
          try {
            const userEmail = sessionStorage.getItem('crear_user_email') || 'anon@crearpsl.com';
            const userName = sessionStorage.getItem('crear_user_name') || 'anon';
            let sedeFound = '';
            let valorAnterior = null;

            // 1. Actualizar en memoria
            Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(s => {
              const ev = allEventsData[s].find(e => e.equipo === equipo && e.start === dateStr);
              if (ev) {
                if (!ev.logistics) ev.logistics = {};
                valorAnterior = ev.logistics[field];
                ev.logistics[field] = value;
                sedeFound = s;
                currentEventoId = `${s.substring(0,3).toUpperCase()}_E${equipo}_${dateStr.replace(/-/g,'').substring(0,8)}`;
              }
            });
            
            // 2. Registrar en audit log local
            const auditEntry = {
              id: 'AUD_' + Date.now(),
              usuario: userEmail,
              nombre_usuario: userName,
              timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
              sede: sedeFound,
              equipo: equipo,
              evento_id: currentEventoId,
              campo: field,
              valor_anterior: valorAnterior !== undefined ? String(valorAnterior) : '',
              valor_nuevo: typeof value === 'boolean' ? (value ? 'SÍ' : 'NO') : String(value),
              accion: `${field}: ${typeof value === 'boolean' ? (value ? 'SÍ' : 'NO') : value}`
            };
            try {
              const auditLog = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crear_audit_log') || '[]');
              auditLog.push(auditEntry);
              // Mantener solo los últimos 500 registros en local
              if (auditLog.length > 500) auditLog.splice(0, auditLog.length - 500);
              localStorage.setItem('crear_audit_log', JSON.stringify(auditLog));
            } catch(ae) { console.warn('Audit log local error:', ae); }

            // 3. Guardar local + encolar para sync
            savePersistent('crear_calendar_logistics', allEventsData);
            
            // 4. Enviar a backend si hay API (incluye datos de auditoría)
            if (API_URL && !API_URL.includes('PEGA_AQUI')) {
              const targetId = `${equipo}_${dateStr.replace(/-/g,'').substring(0,8)}`;
              fetch(API_URL, {
                method: 'POST',
                mode: 'no-cors',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'text/plain'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  action: 'updateLogistics',
                  evento_id: currentEventoId || targetId,
                  [field]: value,
                  _audit: auditEntry
                })
              }).catch(() => {});
            }
            
            // 5. Re-renderizar dashboard de vuelos si el cambio afecta
            if (['trainer_arrival', 'ticket', 'hotel', 'trainer_notified', 'aerolinea', 'numero_vuelo', 'origen', 'destino', 'pnr'].includes(field)) {
              if (typeof renderVuelosActivosDashboard === 'function') {
                renderVuelosActivosDashboard();
              }
            }
            
            // 6. Re-renderizar eventos + toast
            renderEvents(document.getElementById('searchInput')?.value || '');
            showToast(`✅ ${field.replace(/_/g, ' ')} guardado · ${userName}`);
          } catch(e) {
            showToast('❌ Error al guardar', 'error');
          }
        }

        function exportarLogisticaCSV() {
            let rows = [["Sede", "Equipo", "Entrenamiento", "Fecha", "Entrenador", "Tiquete", "Hotel", "Avisado", "Llegada", "Lugar"]];
            Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(sede => {
                allEventsData[sede].forEach(ev => {
                    const l = ev.logistics || {};
                    rows.push([

            const csv = rows.map(r => r.join(",")).join("\n");

        function exportarRespaldoJSON() {

        async function fetchGoogleSheetsTrainers() {
          try {
            // Usar el sheet de entrenadores que contiene la programación
            const SHEET_ID = '1u0tc4GeooPmSwNxZ0CErKGtRU4oD-mO3l--ZSQM-KPs'; // Base de datos centralizada

            const res = await fetch(url);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error al consultar Sheets de entrenadores');
            const text = await res.text();
            const json = JSON.parse(text.substring(47, text.length - 2));
            
            let updated = false;
            
            json.table.rows.forEach(row => {
              // Mapeo correcto según las columnas de EVENTOS: Fecha (0), Sede (1), Equipo (2), Entrenamiento (3), Entrenador (4)
              const rawSede = row.c[1]?.v?.trim();
              const sede = normalizeSedeKey(rawSede);
              const equipo = cleanEquipoFormula(row.c[2]?.v);
              const entrenamiento = row.c[3]?.v?.trim();
              const entrenador = row.c[4]?.v?.trim();
              
              if (sede && equipo && entrenador && allEventsData[sede]) {
                const normEntrenamiento = normalizeStr(entrenamiento || "");
                const isMaestria = normEntrenamiento.includes("MAESTRIA");
                
                // Asignación normal
                allEventsData[sede].forEach(ev => {
                  if (ev.equipo === equipo && (!entrenamiento || normalizeStr(ev.name).includes(normEntrenamiento))) {
                    if (ev.trainer !== entrenador) {
                      ev.trainer = entrenador;
                      updated = true;
                      console.log(`✅ Entrenador actualizado: ${ev.name} - Equipo ${ev.equipo} → ${entrenador}`);
                    }
                  }
                });
                
                // Lógica especial para Maestría con múltiples entrenadores
                if (isMaestria && entrenamiento.includes("/")) {
                  const trainersArray = entrenamiento.split("/").map(t => t.trim());
                  const teamNumbers = equipo.split(/[,y]/).map(t => t.trim());
                  
                  const IMPACTO_STAGES = ["IMPACTO CREACION", "IMPACTO RELACION", "IMPACTO GRATITUD"];
                  
                  teamNumbers.forEach((teamNum, index) => {
                    const assignedTrainer = trainersArray[index];
                    if (!assignedTrainer) return;
                    
                    const targetStage = IMPACTO_STAGES[index] || '';
                    
                    allEventsData[sede].forEach(ev => {
                      if (ev.equipo === String(teamNum) && normalizeStr(ev.name).includes(normalizeStr(targetStage))) {
                        if (ev.trainer !== assignedTrainer) {
                          ev.trainer = assignedTrainer;
                          updated = true;
                          console.log(`✅ Entrenador Maestría actualizado: ${ev.name} - Equipo ${ev.equipo} → ${assignedTrainer}`);
                        }
                      }
                    });
                  });
                }
              }
            });
            
            if (updated) {
              renderEvents();
              if (typeof renderVuelosActivosDashboard === 'function') {
                renderVuelosActivosDashboard();
              }
              showToast('🔄 Entrenadores sincronizados con Google Sheets');
            }
          } catch (e) {
            console.error("Error cargando entrenadores desde Sheets:", e);
          }
        }

        // Actualizar entrenadores cada 10 minutos
        setInterval(fetchGoogleSheetsTrainers, 10 * 60 * 1000);

        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // GOOGLE DRIVE - ESCANEO AUTOMÁTICO DE TIQUETES
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        const DRIVE_FOLDER_ID = '1opVrJrmZBuiSYSlVvTwAXb2Q1_SydvT7';
        const DRIVE_API_KEY = 'TU_API_KEY_DE_GOOGLE_CLOUD'; // Necesitas crear una API key en Google Cloud Console

        async function scanDriveForTickets() {
          try {
            if (DRIVE_API_KEY === 'TU_API_KEY_DE_GOOGLE_CLOUD') {
              console.log('ℹ️ Para activar escaneo automático de Drive, configura DRIVE_API_KEY.');
              return;
            }
            const url = `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?q='${DRIVE_FOLDER_ID}'+in+parents+and+trashed=false&fields=files(id,name,mimeType,createdTime,webContentLink)&key=${DRIVE_API_KEY}&orderBy=createdTime+desc`;
            
            const res = await fetch(url);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Error al consultar Drive');
            
            const data = await res.json();
            const files = data.files || [];
            
            console.log(`📁 Encontrados ${files.length} archivos en Drive`);
            
            // Procesar cada archivo
            for (const file of files) {
              await processDriveFile(file);
            }
            
            showToast(`✅ ${files.length} tiquetes procesados desde Drive`);
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error escaneando Drive:', err);
          }
        }

        async function processDriveFile(file) {
          // Verificar si ya fue procesado (guardar en localStorage)
          const processedFiles = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('processedDriveFiles') || '[]');
          if (processedFiles.includes(file.id)) {
            console.log(`⏭️ Archivo ya procesado: ${file.name}`);
            return;
          }
          
          console.log(`🔄 Procesando: ${file.name}`);
          
          // Si es PDF o imagen, intentar OCR
          if (file.mimeType.includes('pdf') || file.mimeType.includes('image')) {
            try {
              // Descargar archivo
              const fileRes = await fetch(file.webContentLink);
              const blob = await fileRes.blob();
              
              // Crear objeto File para Tesseract
              const fileObj = new File([blob], file.name, { type: file.mimeType });
              
              // Ejecutar OCR
              const worker = await Tesseract.createWorker('spa+eng');
              const { data: { text } } = await worker.recognize(fileObj);
              await worker.terminate();
              
              // Extraer datos del tiquete
              const flightData = extraerDatosTiquete(text);
              
              if (flightData.numero_vuelo) {
                console.log(`✅ Datos extraídos:`, flightData);
                
                // Buscar evento correspondiente y actualizar
                actualizarEventoConDatosVuelo(flightData, file.name);
              }
              
              // Marcar como procesado
              processedFiles.push(file.id);
              localStorage.setItem('processedDriveFiles', JSON.stringify(processedFiles));
              
            } catch (err) {
              console.error(`Error procesando ${file.name}:`, err);
            }
          }
        }

        function actualizarEventoConDatosVuelo(flightData, fileName) {
          // Buscar evento por nombre de archivo o fecha
          Object.keys(allEventsData).forEach(sede => {
            allEventsData[sede].forEach(ev => {
              const log = ev.logistics || {};
              
              // Si el archivo contiene el nombre del entrenador o la fecha del evento
              const trainerMatch = ev.trainer && fileName.toUpperCase().includes(ev.trainer.toUpperCase().split(' ')[0]);
              const dateMatch = new Date(ev.start).toISOString().slice(0, 10) === fileName.match(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/)?.[0];
              
              if (trainerMatch || dateMatch) {
                if (!ev.logistics) ev.logistics = {};
                
                // Actualizar solo si no hay datos previos
                if (!log.aerolinea && flightData.aerolinea) ev.logistics.aerolinea = flightData.aerolinea;
                if (!log.numero_vuelo && flightData.numero_vuelo) ev.logistics.numero_vuelo = flightData.numero_vuelo;
                if (!log.origen && flightData.origen) ev.logistics.origen = flightData.origen;
                if (!log.destino && flightData.destino) ev.logistics.destino = flightData.destino;
                if (!log.pnr && flightData.pnr) ev.logistics.pnr = flightData.pnr;
                
                console.log(`✅ Evento actualizado: ${ev.name} - Equipo ${ev.equipo}`);
              }
            });
          });
          
          // Re-renderizar
          renderEvents();
          if (typeof renderVuelosActivosDashboard === 'function') {
            renderVuelosActivosDashboard();
          }
        }

        // Escanear Drive cada 5 minutos
        setInterval(scanDriveForTickets, 5 * 60 * 1000);

        // Escanear al cargar
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
          setTimeout(scanDriveForTickets, 3000);
        });

        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // DIRECTORIO CREAR PODER SIN LÍMITES - MAPEO AUTOMÁTICO
        // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        const DIRECTORIO_SHEET_1 = '1u0tc4GeooPmSwNxZ0CErKGtRU4oD-mO3l--ZSQM-KPs';
        const DIRECTORIO_SHEET_2 = '1PCwGSYxjNm_ieSHtD2BY6vkDPakFyt8Ctq7rlcmX65k';

        async function fetchDirectorioCREAR() {
          try {
            // Sheet 1 - Directorio principal / DB
            const url1 = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${DIRECTORIO_SHEET_1}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json&gid=1326951636`;
            const res1 = await fetch(url1);
            const text1 = await res1.text();
            const json1 = JSON.parse(text1.substring(47, text1.length - 2));
            
            console.log('📋 Base de datos de logística cargada:', json1.table.rows.length, 'registros');
            
            // Sheet 2 - Directorio principal de personas
            const url2 = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${DIRECTORIO_SHEET_2}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json`;
            const res2 = await fetch(url2);
            const text2 = await res2.text();
            const json2 = JSON.parse(text2.substring(47, text2.length - 2));
            
            console.log('📋 Directorio CREAR personas cargado:', json2.table.rows.length, 'registros');
            
            // Procesar directorio de personas (desde DIRECTORIO_SHEET_2 = 1PCwGSYxjNm con mapeo correcto de columnas)
            const directorio = json2.table.rows.map(row => ({

            showToast('✅ Directorio CREAR sincronizado');

        // Cargar directorio al inicio
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
          setTimeout(fetchDirectorioCREAR, 2000);

        // Actualizar cada 30 minutos
        setInterval(fetchDirectorioCREAR, 30 * 60 * 1000);

        renderSedeTabs();
        renderEvents();
        startSync(); // ← Inicia sync multi-gerente cada 30s
        fetchGoogleSheetsTrainers();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { getFirestore, doc, setDoc, getDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'url';
import { createRequire } from 'module';

dotenv.config({ path: 'c:/Users/josem/Downloads/cpsl-base-template/.env' });

const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY,
  authDomain: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN,
  projectId: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID,
  storageBucket: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET,
  messagingSenderId: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID,
  appId: process.env.VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID
};

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const db = getFirestore(app);

import { USERS_TO_IMPORT as users } from '../src/data/usersToImport.js';

const normalizeRole = (role) => {
  if (!role) return 'miembro';
  const r = role.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (r.includes('coordinador') && (r.includes('c1') || r.includes('c2') || r.includes('cap'))) return 'coord_c1';
  if (r.includes('coordinador') && (r.includes('maestr') || r.includes('mj'))) return 'coord_maestria';
  if (r.includes('gerente')) return 'gerente';
  if (r === 'qt') return 'qt';
  if (r === 'capitan' || r.includes('capit')) return 'capitan';
  if (r.includes('ceo') || r.includes('cco') || r.includes('socio')) return 'direccion';
  return r;
};

const normalizeSede = (sede) => {
  if (!sede) return 'Sede Global';
  const s = sede.trim();
  if (s === 'MED' || s.toLowerCase().includes('medell')) return 'Medellín';
  if (s === 'LIM' || s.toLowerCase().includes('lima')) return 'Lima';
  if (s === 'CUE' || s.toLowerCase().includes('cuenca')) return 'Cuenca';
  if (s === 'GYE' || s.toLowerCase().includes('guayaquil')) return 'Guayaquil';
  if (s === 'MEX' || s.toLowerCase().includes('mex')) return 'México';
  if (s === 'UIO-C1') return 'Quito Ciclo 1';
  if (s === 'UIO-C2') return 'Quito Ciclo 2';
  if (s === 'UIO' || s.toLowerCase().includes('quito')) return 'Quito Ciclo 1';
  if (s === 'INT' || s.toLowerCase().includes('intern')) return 'Internacional';
  if (s.toLowerCase().includes('global')) return 'Sede Global';
  return s;
};

async function syncAllUsers() {
  console.log(`\n🚀 Iniciando sincronización de ${users.length} usuarios a Firestore...`);
  let created = 0, updated = 0, errors = 0;

  for (const user of users) {
    try {
      const uid = user.id || user.emails[0].split('@')[0].replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '_');
      const userRef = doc(db, 'users', uid);
      const existing = await getDoc(userRef);
      
      const userData = {
        id: uid,
        name: user.name,
        role: normalizeRole(user.role),
        sede: normalizeSede(user.sede),
        emails: user.emails.map(e => e.toLowerCase().trim()),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        source: 'bootstrapSync'
      };

      if (existing.exists()) {
        await setDoc(userRef, userData, { merge: true });
        updated++;
      } else {
        await setDoc(userRef, userData);
        created++;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(`  ❌ Error con ${user.name}: ${e.message}`);
      errors++;
    }
  }
  console.log(`  ✅ Creados: ${created} | Actualizados: ${updated} | Errores: ${errors}`);
}

async function createSuperAdmin() {
  console.log('\n👑 Creando documento SuperAdmin en Firestore...');
  const email = 'jose.sanchez@crearpsl.net';
  const uid = 'jose_sanchez_crearpsl';
  const ref = doc(db, 'users', uid);
  await setDoc(ref, {
    id: uid,
    name: 'José Sánchez',
    role: 'direccion',
    sede: 'Sede Global',
    emails: [email, 'jose.sanchez@crearpls.com'],
    isSuperAdmin: true,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    source: 'bootstrapSync'
  }, { merge: true });
  console.log(`  ✅ SuperAdmin (${email}) creado/actualizado en Firestore`);
}

(async () => {
  await syncAllUsers();
  await createSuperAdmin();
  console.log('\n✅ Sincronización completa. Cerrando...');
  process.exit(0);
})();
